name: FunBerry Kids
tagline: A joyful learning playground where children explore and grown-ups stay confidently in control.

slides.title: Learning works better when it feels like play
slides.lead: FunBerry gives children a world they want to revisit while keeping the important decisions in a grown-up space.

items.title: Joy first
items.body: Colourful zones, short games and friendly rewards invite exploration.

items.title: Progress that matters
items.body: Skills and play history help families see where curiosity is growing.

items.title: Grown-up control
items.body: Children play through profiles; account and privacy controls stay with adults.

slides.title: Designed for a family, not one generic user
slides.lead: Each person gets the right level of control, language and complexity.

items.title: Visiting grown-up
items.value: A clear welcome, product promise, sign-in and free account path.

items.title: Parent or guardian
items.goal: “Set it up and keep it safe.”
items.value: Dashboard, child profiles, PINs, progress, settings, export and deletion.

items.title: Child player
items.value: Friendly profile picker, themed zones, games, tickets and rewards.

items.title: Returning family
items.value: Remembered account, fast child selection and persistent progress.

slides.title: The adult sets the stage. The child explores.
slides.lead: The hand-off between grown-up and child is visible, simple and intentionally separated.
slides.footer: One adult account can support multiple children with separate progress

slides.title: The family control centre
slides.lead: Parents can create the right play setup, understand progress and retain control of family data.

slides.title: A playful world with clear choices
slides.lead: Large controls, friendly copy and a vivid reward loop help children act independently without exposing adult account settings.

slides.title: Fun on the surface. Guardrails underneath.
slides.lead: The product avoids pretending that child safety is one switch; it is built from account separation, constrained navigation and adult control.

groups.title: Controlled web content
items: External URLs leave the app safely

groups.title: Responsible design
items: No ads or invented social features
No open chat or stranger contact

slides.title: A native family shell with controlled game reuse
slides.lead: Core family journeys remain native; selected complex games reuse existing content through a tightly constrained bridge.

layers.title: Android + iOS
layers.body: One React Native product with branded platform packaging and icons.

layers.title: Native family shell
layers.body: Auth, dashboard, profiles, picker, zones, rewards, progress and settings.

layers.title: Ticketed game WebView
layers.body: Only authorised complex-game routes run inside the controlled web surface.

layers.title: Existing services
layers.body: Accounts, child state, game tickets, rewards and progress APIs.

slides.title: Verified like a product, not a mock-up
slides.lead: The release path covers the app, its APIs and the database change needed by ticketed play.

slides.title: Prepared for owner-led store submission
slides.lead: The product is not yet store-approved. Credentials, signed iOS testing and store declarations remain controlled owner steps.

slides.title: A family product with a memorable heart
slides.lead: FunBerry is designed to delight children without asking grown-ups to surrender clarity or control.

items.title: Children want to return
items.body: The Berry identity, zones and reward loop create a recognisable world.

items.title: Grown-ups stay informed
items.body: Profiles, progress and account controls make family use understandable.

items.title: The platform can grow
items.body: Native and ticketed-game paths support a broader learning catalogue.
